# UniSkills - Curtin Library

> Self-paced learning modules for university students covering academic writing, study skills, digital literacy, numeracy, and research competencies.

UniSkills is Curtin Library's comprehensive online resource platform designed to support student success across core academic and digital competencies. The platform integrates tools and tutorials for research, data analysis, writing, and study techniques.

## Key Topics

- Academic writing
- Study skills
- Digital literacy
- Research skills
- Referencing
- Assessment preparation
- EndNote
- SPSS
- NVivo
- Qualtrics
- Microsoft Office
- Data analysis
- Note-taking
- Critical thinking
- Time management

## Core Learning Modules

- [UniSkills Homepage](https://uniskills.library.curtin.edu.au): Main portal offering self-paced modules for assessment, study, digital, numeracy, and referencing skills.

## Academic Writing & Research

- [Academic Writing Skills](https://uniskills.library.curtin.edu.au/academic-writing): Comprehensive guides for academic writing including assessment analysis, source finding, note-taking, and referencing techniques.

## Study & Learning Skills

- [Study Skills](https://uniskills.library.curtin.edu.au/study): Essential study guides covering group work, exam preparation, presentations, time management, and critical thinking strategies.

## Digital Tools & Software

- [Digital Skills](https://uniskills.library.curtin.edu.au/digital): Hands-on tutorials for research and productivity software including EndNote, SPSS, NVivo, Qualtrics, Microsoft Word, and Excel.
